# CRT

A cathode-ray tube: curved glass, an aperture-grille, slot or shadow mask, scanlines, phosphor glow, a vignette and a slight flicker. The flicker is at most ±5% brightness and stops when motion is off.

<EffectDemo effect="crt" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { crt } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/crt';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(crt({ preset: 'television' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.curvature = 0.1`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter      | Type                                       | Default      | Range     | Description                                                        |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------ | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `curvature`    | number                                     | `0.1`        | 0 – 0.5   | Bulge of the glass.                                                |
| `mask`         | 'aperture' \| 'slot' \| 'shadow' \| 'none' | `'aperture'` |           | Phosphor layout: vertical stripes, staggered slots or a dot triad. |
| `maskStrength` | number                                     | `0.3`        | 0 – 1     | Visibility of the phosphor mask.                                   |
| `maskScale`    | number                                     | `1`          | 1 – 4 px  | Size of a phosphor.                                                |
| `scanlines`    | number                                     | `0.35`       | 0 – 1     | Darkness of the scanlines.                                         |
| `lineWidth`    | number                                     | `3`          | 1 – 12 px | Scanline period.                                                   |
| `glow`         | number                                     | `0.25`       | 0 – 1     | Phosphor bleed around bright pixels.                               |
| `chromatic`    | number                                     | `0.0015`     | 0 – 0.01  | Red/blue convergence error.                                        |
| `vignette`     | number                                     | `0.35`       | 0 – 1     | Darkening toward the corners of the tube.                          |
| `flicker`      | number                                     | `0.02`       | 0 – 0.1   | Frame-to-frame brightness variation.                               |
| `brightness`   | number                                     | `1.15`       | 0.5 – 2   | Compensates for the light the mask and scanlines take away.        |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset       | Settings                                                                 |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `television` | `curvature: 0.14`, `mask: 'shadow'`, `maskStrength: 0.35`                |
| `arcade`     | `curvature: 0.18`, `mask: 'slot'`, `scanlines: 0.5`, `glow: 0.35`        |
| `monitor`    | `curvature: 0.04`, `mask: 'aperture'`, `scanlines: 0.2`, `vignette: 0.2` |
| `flat`       | `curvature: 0`, `mask: 'none'`, `scanlines: 0.4`, `vignette: 0`          |

Apply one with `crt({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Retro & display · tracked as story X7.4 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Motion:** Settles: when motion is off it switches to still values (`flicker: 0`) without changing your settings.
- **Size:** 5.3 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/crt`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Barrel curvature, aperture-grille and shadow-mask phosphor masks, after common CRT shader techniques.
